Wastewater is currently treated using nine stabilization treatment ponds and four polishing ponds.
Treated wastewater is disposed using percolation basins that have a total surface area of 160 acres.
The WWTF also has 120 acres of land application area but the fields have not been used for disposal since 2009.

The Discharger plans to decommission the 122 acres of treatment ponds and construct an activated sludge treatment system to minimize evapoconcentration of salts. The new system will contain two treatment trains operated in parallel. Each treatment train will consist of a concrete oxidation ditch and a secondary clarifier.
